lenses.verdict: The team burned 3-4x more wall-clock than necessary on M-005 through M-007 because there is no hard "read-goc-first" gate; research happened after failed implementation attempts instead of before, compounding two other structural problems: sequential agent spawning where parallel was possible, and over-sized teams applied to under-scoped tasks before the tier system was established.
whatWorked: M-001 was correctly sized: 1 Engineer, clean execution, Gate 32 delivered. No wasted cycles.

M-002 parallelized 8 agents across independent scopes (CDN intercept + cache hardening + SSRF review), delivering multiple gates in one pass. The Demolition-Sec finding of the unbounded cache map and query-string drop were real HIGH issues caught in parallel with implementation, not after.
M-004 (3 agents) correctly used medium-tier sizing and delivered the 8816ms to 147ms performance win in one pass — scope was clear, pattern was known (truncate), no novel RE required.

M-007 demonstrated the correct approach: 2 Scouts reading deobfuscated.js verbatim before any implementation. Result: replicated goc itemTemplate 1:1, reverted all M-005 and M-006 deviations in a single mission. This is the pattern that should have been the starting point of M-005.

The tiered team-size doctrine (adopted 2026-05-28 per feedback_team_size_8_10.md) is the right structural response — it explicitly codifies 'mobilize only relevant specialists' and flags 'Bundle RE research = Scout x N only (no Engineer until findings in)', which is exactly the gate M-005 was missing.

MAX thinking preamble on every agent, combined with model routing (Sonnet/Haiku for workers, Opus only for architecture/security), was codified correctly. The CLAUDE.md §2.1 statement 'extended thinking ~3-5x more tokens but fewer iterations net cheaper than guess-and-check loop' is borne out by the M-005 churn.

whatFailed.issue: No 'read-goc-first' hard gate caused M-005 through M-007 to be one mission's work spread across three. M-005 invented div+background-image (zero prior evidence it existed in goc). M-006 invented a table-cell wrapper (m006-scout-structure.md confirms goc does NOT use one). M-007 then read deobfuscated.js lines 13335-13363 verbatim and reverted both. If that read had been mandatory at M-005 start, M-006 and M-007 likely collapse into one pass. Conservative estimate: 2 full missions (~20-40 min each at mixed model costs) wasted.
whatFailed.evidence: current_mission.md M-007 context block: 'M-005: gift img -> div background-image (0 intrinsic → broke anonymous cell); M-006 change A: extra table-cell wrapper; M-007 reverted both.' scout-goc-loading-analysis.md (M-005 Scout report) confirms goc itemTemplate at deobfuscated.js:13335-13363 uses plain img — this was READABLE before M-005 shipped.

whatFailed.issue: M-003 was a fully wasted iteration: Commander solo implemented page-mount truncate poll without researching whether the repeat-refreshDataSource call would clobber it. It was superseded immediately. A single Scout read of deobfuscated.js for the refreshDataSource call path would have caught this before any code was written.
whatFailed.evidence: current_mission.md M-007 context: 'M-003 page-mount truncate poll: Commander SOLO. SUPERSEDED — clobbered by repeat refreshDataSource. A wasted iteration (no research first).' CLAUDE.md §1.3 principle 'Root Cause Before Fix / Không vá theo cảm giác' was violated on M-003.

whatFailed.issue: M-002 (8-agent large mission) included a Demolition-Electron agent that raised a HIGH 'double-slash' bug which Commander verified was a false positive, requiring an extra verification cycle. The false positive came from a reviewer without sufficient context on the URL construction pattern. A more targeted scope brief or a cheaper Haiku-tier static check first would have filtered this before escalating to Commander.
whatFailed.evidence: Mission brief for M-002 states 'Demolition-Electron raised a HIGH double-slash bug that Commander VERIFIED was a FALSE POSITIVE (wasted a verification cycle).' The real issues (unbounded cache map, query-string drop) came from Demolition-Sec, not the general Demolition agent.

whatFailed.issue: Two Scout reports for M-006 (m006-scout-structure.md and m006-scout-css.md) reached CONTRADICTORY root-cause conclusions: Scout-Structure said the container is flex and collapse is due to anonymous table-cell with zero intrinsic width; Scout-CSS said the container is table-cell (DevExtreme dxdark fixed table-layout) and collapse is due to table-layout:fixed column allocation. Both reports recommend different primary fixes. No reconciliation file exists for M-006 (unlike M-001 which has mission-001-reconciliation.md). Without reconciliation, the Engineer is left with two contradicting diagnoses and picks one, risking the wrong fix.
whatFailed.evidence: m006-scout-structure.md line 17: '.dx-list-item-content is NOT display:table -- it is flex'. m006-scout-css.md line 73: '.dx-list-item-content is NOT flexbox in the DevExtreme dxdark theme. It is display: table-cell.' No m006-reconciliation.md exists in .codex/team/.

whatFailed.issue: M-006 fix was deployed and then fully reverted by M-007 — meaning all wall-clock on M-006 (4 Scouts + Engineer + potentially Apothecary) produced zero net value. The 8-agent Large classification for M-006 amplified this waste: 8 agents worth of tokens spent on a fix that had zero shelf life.
whatFailed.evidence: current_mission.md M-007 objective: 'Revert M-005 div-bg AND M-006 wrapper. goc simply uses img src directly.' m006-scout-structure.md and m006-scout-css.md are both dated 2026-05-29 for a fix immediately reversed the same day.

recommendations: Codify 'read-goc-first' as a MANDATORY hard gate (not a suggestion) for any UI-rendering bug in blockScript/itemTemplate/earlyCss. Concrete rule: before ANY Engineer is spawned on a bundle UI surface, at least one Scout MUST deliver a report citing the exact deobfuscated.js line range that covers the affected render function. If no Scout report exists in .codex/team/ for that surface, the mission is not cleared to move past research phase. Add this as §0.1 in CLAUDE.md under the 'Workflow chuẩn khi gặp UI bug' section (currently §0.0), where step 3 already says 'grep deobfuscated.js' but does not enforce it as a blocking gate before implementation.

Require a reconciliation file (mission-NNN-reconciliation.md) before Engineer spawn whenever 2+ Scouts run in parallel on the same surface. M-006 had two Scouts with contradictory diagnoses and no reconciliation — the Engineer picked the wrong option and produced a fix that was reverted one mission later. The reconciliation step exists in the doctrine (CLAUDE.md §2.1 rule 6) but was skipped for M-006. Make it explicit: if parallel Scouts disagree on root cause, Commander reconciles BEFORE Engineer spawns.

Re-classify bundle UI bug missions: the current template in SKILL.md §1 lists 'UI bug fix = Strategist + Scout-Bundle + Scout-Backend + Scout-DOM + Engineer + ...' (8-10 agents). For a pure itemTemplate/CSS surface bug where the goc source is readable, this is over-sized. The correct minimum is: Scout-Goc (read deobfuscated.js for affected render function) + Scout-CSS (if DevExtreme layout involved) + Commander reconcile + Engineer-Haiku (mechanical replication). That is 2-3 agents, not 8-10. Reserve 8-10 for genuinely novel UI surfaces where no goc source is readable.

Add a DOMAIN-specific research asset index as a table in CLAUDE.md §0.0. Currently the 'Quick context map' lists files by surface area but does not map which deobfuscated.js line ranges cover each UI surface. A one-line table entry per known surface (e.g., 'itemTemplate gift/event: deobfuscated.js:13327-13396') means future Scouts have a starting line number instead of running a blind grep. This directly eliminates the cold-start cost on every bundle RE mission.

For Demolition agents reviewing novel network/URL patterns (like the M-002 double-slash case), add a scope brief requirement: the Mission Brief MUST include the relevant existing pattern from CLAUDE.md Gates (e.g., Gate 33 URL construction) so the reviewer has authoritative context before flagging. This turns false positives into confirmed patterns, cutting the Commander verification cycle.

The tier system is correctly designed but the Trivial/Easy boundary needs one explicit carve-out: 'Known-pattern bundle UI bug where goc line range is already cited in CLAUDE.md Gates = Easy tier (1 Scout + 1 Engineer), NOT Medium or Large.' Without this carve-out, the natural tendency is to default to Medium/Large for any bundle-touching work, reproducing the M-006 over-sizing problem.
lenses.proposedStructuralChange: Add a two-phase gate to the UI bug mission protocol that splits research from implementation into separate, explicitly sequenced sub-missions: Phase 1 (Research Gate) dispatches only Scout roles with a hard deliverable requirement — a .codex/team/mNNN-goc-[surface].md file citing exact deobfuscated.js line numbers and the verbatim goc element/CSS structure for the affected surface, plus a Commander reconciliation if 2+ Scouts run. Phase 2 (Implementation) is blocked until Phase 1 deliverable exists and Commander has written a one-paragraph 'deviation from goc' statement. This collapses the M-005+M-006+M-007 three-mission pattern (research-after-failure) into a single two-phase mission (research-before-implementation), and makes team size for Phase 2 deterministic: if goc source is readable and deviation is clear, Engineer-Haiku suffices; if root cause is still ambiguous after Phase 1, escalate to Sonnet before writing a line of code.

lenses.verdict: Model routing doctrine is sound on paper, but before 2026-05-28 all agents defaulted to Opus (the parent), making every mission 3-5x more expensive and slower than necessary; the M-005/M-006/M-007 churn then proved that even correctly-routed agents burn tokens on invented fixes when the read-goc-first gate is absent.
whatWorked: M-002 8-agent mission: Demolition-Sec (Opus) found 2 REAL security issues (unbounded cache Map, query-string key divergence in prewarm vs proxy route) - the depth that justified Opus spend. The scout-cache-consistency.md report verifying all three cache-key components also delivered concrete, low-false-positive output worth its Sonnet cost.
M-004 3-agent truncate fix (8816ms to 147ms): lean team matched the scope. No Strategist or Demolition-Sec overhead. Correct tier assignment.
M-002 Scout-Bundle-CDN (Sonnet): produced a 291-line impact matrix across 53 files with zero guessing - exactly the high-recall, systematic work Sonnet does well at lower cost than Opus.

M-006 4-Scout convergence on table-layout:fixed root cause: multiple Scouts (m006-scout-structure.md, m006-scout-css.md) triangulated the DevExtreme anonymous-table-cell collapse mechanism correctly via evidence from dxdark.css and deobfuscated.js, with no invented hypothesis surviving past the first evidence check.

The max-thinking preamble, once codified (2026-05-28), reduced per-agent iteration counts in M-007: 2 agents (Opus + Sonnet) read deobfuscated.js verbatim and produced a 1:1 goc replication that closed 3 prior missions in a single pass.
M-001 single-Engineer prewarm: correctly classified Trivial/Easy, Commander solo + 1 specialist, no ceremony, clean Gate 32 documentation.

whatFailed.issue: Pre-2026-05-28 all agents defaulted to Opus because model: param was not mandatory, making the M-002 8-agent mission run at full Opus cost across roles (Apothecary, Librarian, Scout-single) that doctrine now routes to Haiku or Sonnet. The feedback_subagent_model_routing.md memory records the user explicitly correcting this: 'con nào cũng opus thì hơi lâu'. Estimated 3-4x overspend vs the mixed model formula for any mission before that date.
whatFailed.evidence: feedback_subagent_model_routing.md (originSessionId 37988fe1, 2026-05-28); CLAUDE.md §2.1 'Speed/cost impact: 8 agents all Opus ≈ 30-60 min'

whatFailed.issue: M-002 Demolition-Electron raised a HIGH 'double-slash' false positive that triggered a Commander verification cycle. A Sonnet-routed Demolition would have lower confidence but roughly equivalent false-positive rate on a mechanical URL-path check; the Opus spend did not eliminate this false positive. The verification cycle cost was pure overhead.
whatFailed.evidence: Mission history M-002 as described in the prompt; scout-bundle-cdn-audit.md (M-002 mission marker)

whatFailed.issue: M-005 spawned approximately 6 guess-and-check iterations (remove placeholder, onerror-clear, img-to-div-background, ::before neutralize) with no read-goc-first gate. Each iteration likely involved at least 1 Engineer (Sonnet) + verification probes. The div-background invention was the most expensive error: it changed element type from img (replaced, 40px intrinsic) to div (non-replaced, 0px intrinsic), directly causing M-006. The root cause was available in deobfuscated.js:13344 on the first Scout read. Estimated 4-5 wasted agent-turns at Sonnet cost.
whatFailed.evidence: m006-scout-structure.md §goc-comparison: 'Native bundle (deobfuscated.js:13344) uses img. An img is a REPLACED ELEMENT... Our M-005 patch switched img to div+background-image... This is the root cause'; scout-goc-loading-analysis.md: 'itemTemplate img src = image?.url_list[0]'

whatFailed.issue: M-006 8-agent LARGE classification for an icon layout fix was over-sized. The root cause (table-layout:fixed collapsing non-replaced element) required 2 Scouts and 1 Engineer. The remaining 5+ agents in a nominal LARGE roster added overhead without proportionate signal. The fix was later reverted entirely by M-007.
whatFailed.evidence: CLAUDE.md §2.1 tier table (cross-cutting/high-risk = Large; icon layout is CSS-domain, low-risk, no DB/security/Electron surface); current_mission.md M-007 'revert M-005 div-bg... revert M-006 wrapper'

whatFailed.issue: M-003 was Commander solo with no read-goc research, producing a fix that was immediately superseded by the discovery that repeat refreshDataSource clobbered the truncation. A single pre-work Scout pass (Sonnet, ~1 tool call) against deobfuscated.js would have found the clobber before any code was written. The entire mission was wasted iteration at Commander (Opus) cost.
whatFailed.evidence: Mission history M-003: 'SUPERSEDED - clobbered by repeat refreshDataSource. A wasted iteration (no research first)'; scout-goc-loading-analysis.md confirms refreshDataSource behavior documented in deobfuscated.js

whatFailed.issue: Max-thinking preamble was not enforced before 2026-05-28 (feedback_max_thinking_all_agents.md records it was added that date). M-005 and M-006 iterations show the classic symptom of agents acting on first plausible hypothesis without eliminating alternatives via evidence. The preamble's explicit 'think 3-5 hypotheses, eliminate via evidence, design minimal fix BEFORE first tool call' instruction directly addresses the M-005 failure mode.
whatFailed.evidence: feedback_max_thinking_all_agents.md: 'User directed 2026-05-28... mọi thằng đều max thinking nha'; CLAUDE.md §2.1 thinking-preamble added after M-005/M-006 churn

recommendations: Add a HARD GATE: before any bundle-UI implementation mission the Commander must confirm a Scout (Sonnet, read-only, max-thinking) has read the relevant deobfuscated.js section and produced a findings file. Gate is not optional even for Easy-tier missions touching the itemTemplate or blockScript. Cost: 1 Sonnet Scout pass (~0.3-0.5 USD, ~15 min) vs 4-6 wasted Sonnet/Opus iterations (~2-4 USD, 60-120 min).

Enforce model routing by making the per-agent budget table (SKILL.md §1 'Per-agent budgets') include a hard max_cost_usd per role that is calibrated to the assigned model tier. Apothecary-static at Haiku has max_cost_usd=0.5; if it is accidentally spawned as Opus its budget cap would be exceeded immediately, surfacing the misconfiguration rather than silently overspending.

Reclassify CSS/bundle-UI layout bugs explicitly as DOMAIN-CSS tier, not defaulting to LARGE. LARGE requires cross-cutting, security, or DB surface. Icon layout bugs touch 1 template file and 1 CSS file - that is Medium at most. The doctrine table in CLAUDE.md §2.1 should add an explicit domain column so Commander cannot over-classify.

When a mission is fully reverted by the next mission (M-005 div-bg and M-006 wrapper both reverted by M-007), add a post-mortem flag to decisions.md noting 'revert-on-next-mission: yes'. Tracking this rate makes cost waste visible. If 2+ consecutive missions on the same surface all get reverted, the Commander must escalate to a mandatory read-goc Scout before proceeding.

The max-thinking preamble costs 3-5x tokens per agent turn but eliminates multi-turn guess-and-check loops. The net math is clearly positive (confirmed by M-007 resolving 3 prior missions in 1 pass). Make the preamble non-removable by embedding it in the SKILL.md Agent spawn template rather than relying on Commander memory to include it.

For Demolition (code-reviewer) agents on non-architectural missions, route to Sonnet and add an explicit instruction to cite the specific file:line for every finding before labeling it HIGH. The M-002 Demolition-Electron false positive on the double-slash path could have been short-circuited if the agent was required to verify the URL construction by reading the actual code rather than reasoning about it.
lenses.proposedStructuralChange: Add a mandatory read-goc Scout gate as a pre-condition step in the LARGE and Medium UI-bug mission templates: before Engineer spawns, a single Scout (Sonnet, model explicitly set, max-thinking preamble, read-only tools, budget cap $1.50) must read the relevant deobfuscated.js section and write a findings file. Commander reconciles the Scout output, then and only then spawns the Engineer. This gate is enforced by adding it as Step 0 in the CLAUDE.md §2.1 UI bug fix roster: 'Scout-Goc-RE [S, read-only] → mandatory first, writes .codex/team/mNNN-goc-findings.md → Engineer spawns only after'. M-007 proved this pattern resolves 3 missions worth of churn in a single pass at roughly Sonnet Scout cost (~$0.5) vs the ~$8-15 spent on M-005 and M-006 combined iterations.

lenses.lens: QUALITY / CORRECTNESS — Verification Layers, False Consensus, goc-Source Gate
lenses.verdict: The verification layer CAUGHT real bugs (M-002) but also MANUFACTURED false confidence in M-005/M-006, converging 4+ agents onto invented, non-goc solutions that M-007 had to fully revert — a multi-mission correctness failure caused by the absence of a mandatory "read goc FIRST" gate before any bundle-UI implementation.
whatWorked: M-002: Demolition-Sec (Opus) independently identified 2 real security/correctness issues — unbounded cache Map and query-string drop from CDN redirect. Both were real, both were fixed. The multi-layer review with dedicated Sec role earned its cost here.

M-004: 3-agent medium team (Scout + Engineer + Apothecary) correctly diagnosed and fixed the loadTriggers truncation (8816ms to 147ms) without inventing extraneous solutions. Scope was constrained and evidence-driven because the Scout read deobfuscated.js line ranges explicitly.

M-006 Scout-Item-Structure (m006-scout-structure.md): The report produced a rigorous CSS table-model analysis that correctly explained WHY goc img (replaced element, intrinsic 40px) survived while the M-005 div+background-image (non-replaced, 0 intrinsic) collapsed the anonymous table-cell. The root cause explanation is technically accurate and detailed.

M-007 'read goc VERBATIM' strategy: 2 Scouts (Opus + Sonnet) reading deobfuscated.js:13327-13396 and replicating itemTemplate 1:1 resolved everything M-005 and M-006 broke in one pass. This is the correct methodology for any bundle-UI task.
The tiered team-size doctrine (Trivial/Easy/Medium/Large) correctly kept M-001 as 1-agent and M-004 as 3-agent, avoiding over-engineering on scoped tasks.

CLAUDE.md §1 Principle 3 ('Root Cause Before Fix') and the Bug Fix Workflow (§6 step 3: 'Compare working pattern') explicitly require finding similar working code in the repo first. The doctrine IS correct on paper.

whatFailed.issue: M-005 produced a fully INVENTED solution (div+background-image) that never existed in goc. Approximately 6 guess-and-check iterations were spent on a wrong diagnosis. The critical failure: no agent was tasked to read deobfuscated.js:13335-13363 FIRST to confirm what goc actually used for the icon element. The team diagnosed the symptom (images not loading) and invented a workaround (swap img to div+bg) without verifying goc's own implementation. This directly violates CLAUDE.md §6 step 3 ('Compare working pattern') but no enforcement mechanism enforced it.
whatFailed.evidence: scout-goc-loading-analysis.md (M-005 postmortem): 'M-005 patch switched img to div+background-image to avoid cross-origin img quirks. The proxy URL solves the load problem, but the element-type change from img (replaced, intrinsic 40px) to div (non-replaced, intrinsic 0) causes the anonymous-cell collapse.' Also current_mission.md M-007: 'goc simply uses img src directly.'

whatFailed.issue: M-006 compounded M-005's invented structure by adding a table-cell wrapper and flexbox alignment overrides to FIX a problem caused by the non-goc div element. This made two agents AGREE on and EXTEND a wrong foundation. Multi-agent consensus here created false confidence: 4 Scouts converged on 'table-layout:fixed collapses content-less icon column' as the root cause, produced a technically correct CSS analysis, and recommended a fix — but that fix was a workaround for a problem that only existed because M-005 deviated from goc. The agents never asked 'did goc have this problem?' which would have immediately revealed the real root cause was the element type substitution.
whatFailed.evidence: m006-scout-structure.md: 'Our M-005 patch switched img to div+background-image... The ONLY layout-relevant difference is replaced vs non-replaced element.' current_mission.md M-007: 'M-006 change A: extra table-cell wrapper around icon' and 'M-006 change B: label CSS deviations'. Both were reverted by M-007.

whatFailed.issue: The Demolition-Electron agent in M-002 raised a HIGH-severity 'double-slash' false positive that required a Commander verification cycle to dismiss. A false HIGH from Demolition wastes review bandwidth and degrades the signal-to-noise ratio of the verification layer. The agent apparently matched a syntactic pattern without tracing actual runtime behavior. This is a Demolition-role calibration failure: flagging pattern-match guesses as HIGH instead of reserving HIGH for confirmed behavioral bugs.
whatFailed.evidence: Mission history summary: 'Demolition-Electron raised a HIGH double-slash bug that Commander VERIFIED was a FALSE POSITIVE (wasted a verification cycle).'

whatFailed.issue: M-003 (page-mount truncate poll) was superseded and wasted because the Commander acted solo without prior research into whether a competing behavior (repeat refreshDataSource) already existed in goc. CLAUDE.md §6 step 3 and §1 'Root Cause Before Fix' were violated in solo mode just as they were in multi-agent mode — the doctrine gap is in enforcement, not just in team composition.
whatFailed.evidence: Mission history: 'M-003 Commander SOLO. SUPERSEDED — clobbered by repeat refreshDataSource. A wasted iteration (no research first).'

whatFailed.issue: The current verification gate system has no mandatory 'goc-source comparison' step. CLAUDE.md §0.0 says 'grep decompiled/modules/deobfuscated.js for symbol' as step 3 of the standard workflow, but only 'if no gate match' — it is listed as a fallback, not a FIRST step for bundle-UI work. This means an agent can attempt a bundle-UI fix by going gate-lookup → guess → implement without ever reading what goc actually does. The gate-match shortcut is appropriate for known, catalogued patterns but actively harmful when the agent mis-classifies a novel problem as a known gate.
whatFailed.evidence: CLAUDE.md §0.0 Workflow: '1. Read §Gates... 2. If gate match apply fix 3. If not match grep deobfuscated.js'. M-005 burned multiple iterations before anyone read deobfuscated.js:13335 to see goc uses img. The grep-first step was never mandatory for new bundle-UI issues.

recommendations: Add a hard-gate 'READ-GOC-FIRST' protocol as the ZEROTH step (before §Gates lookup) for any bundle-UI task. Specifically: before any Engineer touches itemTemplate, fieldTemplate, or any bundle-rendered UI element, a Scout MUST read the corresponding lines of decompiled/modules/deobfuscated.js and output the exact element structure goc uses. The Scout report is a BLOCKER — Engineer cannot start until Scout delivers it. This gate would have made M-005 a 1-pass mission instead of 6.

Introduce a 'goc-delta checker' role in the Demolition review step: after Engineer writes code, a Demolition (or the Commander) explicitly diffs the proposed implementation against the Scout's goc extract and flags ANY structural deviation. Even 'seemingly equivalent' deviations (img vs div+background-image, display:table-row vs flex-row) must be justified in the review output. Undocumented deviations from goc are treated as blocking findings.

Recalibrate the Demolition (code-reviewer) role for this project: findings that are PATTERN-MATCH only (no behavioral trace, no runtime evidence) MUST be labeled MEDIUM or LOW, not HIGH. Reserve HIGH for findings backed by traced execution path or confirmed runtime test. This prevents false-positive HIGH findings (M-002 Demolition-Electron double-slash) from consuming a Commander verification cycle.

The multi-agent consensus anti-pattern needs explicit doctrine. When N agents converge on the same root cause and recommended fix, that consensus is only valid if at least one agent traced the hypothesis back to goc source. If no agent verified against goc, consensus provides ZERO correctness guarantee — it only amplifies the same wrong assumption. Add to CLAUDE.md §2.1 a note: 'Consensus without goc-source verification is not evidence. Multiple agents reading each other's outputs and agreeing is not the same as independent verification from primary source (deobfuscated.js).'

For the specific domain of 'bundle-UI rendering bugs' (itemTemplate, fieldTemplate, CSS overrides of bundle-rendered elements), treat deobfuscated.js as the AUTHORITATIVE SPEC, not an optional reference. Every proposed fix must be expressible as: (a) exact replication of goc line X-Y, or (b) a documented, justified deviation with explicit rationale for why goc's approach cannot be used directly. This framing would have stopped M-005's div+background-image the moment it was proposed, since goc:13344 clearly uses img.

Add a post-mission 'revert risk' check to reconciliation reports: if a mission's changes were NOT a direct goc replication, the reconciliation must explicitly state the risk that a future 'match-goc' mission will revert them. This creates forward visibility so the Commander can weigh the stability of invented solutions vs. goc-faithful ones before committing.
lenses.proposedStructuralChange: Create a dedicated 'Scout-Goc' sub-role that is MANDATORY on every bundle-UI mission (not optional like the current Scout-Bundle). Scout-Goc has a single, non-negotiable deliverable before any Engineer spawns: a markdown file containing the VERBATIM goc source lines (deobfuscated.js line range) for the UI element being modified, plus a one-table diff of 'goc structure vs current clone structure'. No Engineer agent may begin until this file exists. This makes 'read goc first' structurally enforced by the mission protocol, not dependent on individual agent judgment or Commander memory — eliminating the doctrine gap that caused M-005, M-006, and their subsequent revert in M-007.

lenses.lens: STRUCTURE — org axes (ROLE + SIZE-TIER) vs a 2-axis difficulty x DOMAIN model, plus the missing RE-first hard gate
lenses.verdict: The SIZE-tier axis is sound, but the single-axis role model is wrong for THIS codebase: work is dominated by 5 stable DOMAINS and the org lacks a mandatory "replicate-gốc-first" gate — the root cause of the 3-mission M-005→M-007 burn.
whatWorked: Difficulty-tiered sizing is genuinely right and has evidence behind it: M-001 (1 agent, clean, Gate 32) and M-004 (3 agents, 8816ms→147ms, Gate 34) show right-sized teams hitting clean gates. The memory file even self-corrects the earlier always-8-10 rule, citing trigger-truncate as over-spawned.

The war-room is ALREADY de-facto domain-organized — the file names prove the work clusters by domain, not role: scout-bundle-cdn-audit (bundle-RE), scout-cache-consistency (backend-Node), apothecary-static-verify (Electron-main), m006-scout-css + m006-scout-structure + m007-goc-dropdowncss (CSS/DevExtreme). The org spontaneously partitioned by domain even though doctrine never told it to.

M-002's multi-Scout parallel domain split (CDN-audit + cache-consistency + Electron-static-verify) worked: Demolition-Sec found 2 REAL issues (unbounded cache Map, query-string key divergence in scout-cache-consistency.md §Inconsistency-1) that a single generalist would likely have missed.
Model routing per role is a real cost lever (SKILL.md §1 claims 3-4x cheaper, 10-20 min vs 30-60 min) and is orthogonal to the structure question — keep it.

whatFailed.issue: No mandatory 'read-gốc / replicate-1:1' HARD GATE before bundle-UI implementation. This is THE structural gap. The team invented solutions (M-005 img→div-background; M-006 flexbox/table-cell wrapper) for ~6+3 iterations before M-007 simply read decompiled/modules/deobfuscated.js:13335-13363 verbatim and reverted everything to gốc's plain .
whatFailed.evidence: current_mission.md M-007 objective: 'extract EXACT gốc itemTemplate ... replicate 1:1' reverting M-005 div-bg AND M-006 wrapper; scout-goc-loading-analysis.md confirms gốc itemTemplate at deobfuscated.js:13344 was always a plain img.

whatFailed.issue: The decisive RE evidence existed by M-006 but was buried under invented fixes — proving the failure is org/process, not capability. m006-scout-structure.md literally states 'Native bundle uses img ... Our M-005 patch switched img to div+background ... This is the root cause' yet in the SAME report recommended inventing a flexbox restructure (Option b) instead of the obvious 'revert to gốc img'.
whatFailed.evidence: m006-scout-structure.md lines 99-105 (root cause stated) vs lines 135-205 (recommends NEW flexbox Option b); m007-goc-dropdowncss.md then had to walk back M-006 overrides.

whatFailed.issue: Difficulty-tier sizing mis-classifies bundle-RE: a 'Scout-single-file Haiku' is specced for low file-count, but reading obfuscated bundle code is NEVER trivial regardless of #files. The tier checklist (#files, scope, risk, known/novel, reversible) has no DOMAIN dimension, so it under-powers RE work.

recommendations: Adopt a 2-axis model: DIFFICULTY (keep the existing trivial/easy/medium/large size tiers) x DOMAIN (which standing squad + which RE-gate applies). Difficulty sets HEADCOUNT; domain sets WHO and the GATES. The size tier alone decides nothing about competence — domain does.

Define 5 standing domain squads matching the observed clusters: (A) Bundle-RE [Scout-bundle Sonnet/Opus + decompiled/deobfuscated.js owner], (B) Backend-Node [Engineer + Apothecary-runtime, owns routes/services/proxy/cache], (C) Electron-main [Engineer-electron + Apothecary-static, owns electron/main.js], (D) CSS/DevExtreme-layout [Engineer + Demolition, owns earlyCss.txt + dx css], (E) blockScript-template-IIFE [Engineer-bundle + Demolition-Sec, owns blockScript.txt]. Commander still right-sizes headcount per difficulty within the squad.

Install a MANDATORY 'Scout-gốc-first' HARD GATE for any mission touching domains A, D, or E (anything that overrides bundle render). The gate's exit criterion: a written extract of the EXACT gốc symbol from decompiled/modules/deobfuscated.js (file:line) BEFORE any Engineer edit. No gốc extract = mission cannot leave SCOUTING. This is the single change that would have collapsed M-005→M-007 into one mission.

Add a doctrine rule: 'Replicate-before-invent.' If gốc does X (e.g. plain ), the fix MUST start by replicating X verbatim; inventing a NEW structure (div-bg, flexbox wrapper) is only permitted AFTER a verbatim replication is proven to fail, with the failure evidence written to the war-room. M-006's scout had the gốc answer and still invented — the rule forces the replicate path first.

Add DOMAIN as the FIRST item in the difficulty-assessment checklist and let domain VETO the model tier: bundle-RE (domain A) and security-touching always bump Scout/reviewer to >= Sonnet (Opus for novel), regardless of file count. Kill the 'Scout-single-file Haiku' default for obfuscated-bundle reads.

Anchor reviewers to their domain to stop cross-domain false positives: an Electron change is reviewed by the Electron squad's reviewer, not a generic Demolition. This directly addresses M-002's wasted double-slash verification cycle.
Codify a per-domain regression checklist owned by each squad (CLAUDE.md §1.11 already has a global one) so verification is domain-scoped and gốc-anchored, not a generic feature sweep.
lenses.proposedStructuralChange: Replace the single-axis (ROLE x SIZE-TIER) org with an explicit 2-axis grid: DIFFICULTY-tier sets headcount, DOMAIN (Bundle-RE / Backend-Node / Electron-main / CSS-DevExtreme / blockScript-IIFE) selects a standing squad and its gates — and make a 'Scout-gốc-first' extract from decompiled/modules/deobfuscated.js a HARD, non-skippable gate (mission stays in SCOUTING until a gốc symbol file:line is documented) for every mission that overrides bundle UI. This one gate, placed at the DOMAIN-A/D/E entry point, is what M-005 was missing.

lenses.verdict: The war-room protocol produced genuine signal when it was followed (M-001/M-002/M-007 reconciliations are solid artifacts), but coordination tooling broke down at three concrete points: agents could not write their .md report files, current_state.json went stale and was never updated past M-001, and the mission-declare → spawn → reconcile loop was skipped entirely for M-003 and M-005, which are exactly the two missions that burned the most wasted work.
whatWorked: M-001 (bundle-scouts) is the clearest coordination success: 2 Scouts owned non-overlapping files (app.js vs modules.js), wrote separate .md reports, and Commander produced mission-001-reconciliation.md that unified both into one root cause (loginChannel gap) with concrete follow-up missions. This is the template the doctrine was meant to enforce.

M-002 (CDN intercept) shows the full sub-agent report cycle working: Scout-Bundle-CDN wrote scout-bundle-cdn-audit.md, Apothecary wrote apothecary-static-verify.md with a formal 12-point checklist, Librarian produced mission-002-gate-drafts.md with Gate 32+33 ready for CLAUDE.md. Cross-references between reports (e.g., Apothecary explicitly references 'If M-2026-05-28-001 has wired the route') show agents reading each other's files via the war-room, not inline.

File ownership rules prevented write conflicts across all observed missions. No two agents edited the same file in the same mission. Scout reports are read-only artifacts; Engineer owns the write targets. This is working as designed.

Per-role model routing is correctly specified in SKILL.md §1 and CLAUDE.md §2.1 and codified in feedback_subagent_model_routing.md. The M-006 team correctly used Opus for Scout-Goc-ItemTemplate (deep deobfuscated.js RE) and Sonnet for Scout-Goc-DropdownCSS (CSS audit). The tiering is actually being applied.

The max-thinking preamble policy (CLAUDE.md §2.1, SKILL.md §1) is cited in every mission declaration observed. M-007 current_mission.md explicitly marks each agent with [Opus + max thinking] and [Sonnet + max thinking]. This is the one coordination directive that is consistently carried through to spawn prompts.

decisions.md exists as an append-only immutable record and was used correctly: the Gate 30i v1-v4 iteration post-mortem ('PROBE BEFORE SEED') was appended rather than overwriting the prior entry. This preserves the audit trail of past failures.

recommendations: Make sub-agent write access a first-class infrastructure requirement. The docstring in CLAUDE.md §2.1 says 'Cross-talk qua .codex/team/*.md files' but the Apothecary's own report (apothecary-static-verify.md) shows the Bash classifier blocked file writes and forced inline reporting. Until agents can reliably write to .codex/team/ in the Windows/PowerShell environment without hitting classifier blocks, the coordination protocol is structurally unreliable. Concretely: test write access as part of mission DECLARE (Commander writes current_mission.md, then confirms it exists before spawning); if a sub-agent cannot write its report, Commander must manually transcribe the inline report into a .md file before the mission is considered reconciled.

Enforce the reconciliation gate as a hard prerequisite for the next mission. Currently Commander can move from M-005 to M-006 to M-007 without any reconciliation artifact. Proposed rule: Commander may not spawn the next mission until (a) a mission-NNN-reconciliation.md exists for the prior mission and (b) current_state.json active_mission has been set to null. This forces a pause where conflicting Scout recommendations are adjudicated before Engineer receives a work order. The M-006 two-Scout conflict (flexbox vs table-cell) would have been caught here.

When multiple Scouts return conflicting fix blueprints, add an explicit Commander adjudication step to the reconciliation template. The reconciliation .md should have a mandatory section: 'Scout conflicts' with each disagreement listed and Commander's chosen resolution. This prevents Engineer from picking a third option that satisfies neither. Apply this retroactively: m006 produced two contradictory recommendations; if Commander had written a reconciliation picking Option (a) (table-cell) with explicit justification, the M-006 wrapper would have been built to spec and M-007 might not have been needed.

Add a current_state.json update as a required post-step for EVERY mission completion, not just on init. The file currently sits at 2026-05-27T08:45:00Z and is five missions stale. Concretely: add to SKILL.md §1 mission protocol step 7 an explicit 'UPDATE current_state.json' line with the required fields: last_updated (ISO), active_mission (null on complete), last_completed_mission, and a missions_completed array. Commander can write this directly since it is a trivial file edit, no agent spawn needed.

For bundle RE / obfuscated code tasks, enforce a 'read gốc first' hard gate in the mission DECLARE template before any Engineer is spawned. The prompt already contains 'Workflow chuẩn khi gặp UI bug' in CLAUDE.md §0.0 (step 3: grep deobfuscated.js), but this is written as a Commander-solo workflow, not enforced as a Scout prerequisite for team missions. The M-005 failure (div-background invented, 6 iterations) and M-006 revert (wrapper later undone by M-007) both trace to Engineers receiving fix mandates before a Scout had confirmed the gốc structure. Add to CLAUDE.md §2.1 mission templates a required first agent for all UI bug missions: 'Scout-Goc [Sonnet, read-only, reads deobfuscated.js + confirms gốc element structure] — MUST complete and write report BEFORE Engineer spawns.' This converts the informal principle into an enforced sequencing gate.

Clarify the reconciliation artifact format: mission-001-reconciliation.md is a rich synthesis; mission-002-gate-drafts.md is a Gate draft (different purpose). These serve different functions and should not be used interchangeably. Propose two distinct artifact types: (a) mission-NNN-reconciliation.md (always required for Medium/Large missions — contains root cause unification, Scout conflict resolution, chosen fix direction, follow-up missions); (b) mission-NNN-gate-draft.md (optional — Gate text ready for CLAUDE.md, produced by Librarian). The current conflation means reconciliation is sometimes skipped when a Librarian Gate draft already exists, even though root cause unification did not happen.
lenses.proposedStructuralChange: Add a two-phase sequencing rule to the mission DECLARE template in SKILL.md §1: Phase 1 (Read-only Scouts, max-thinking) must write reports to .codex/team/ and Commander must produce a reconciliation .md before Phase 2 (Engineer with write access) is spawned. For bundle UI missions this means Scout-Goc always runs in Phase 1 before any Engineer receives a file ownership grant. This converts the current informal 'research before fix' principle into a hard spawn dependency enforced in the mission protocol, directly addressing the M-003/M-005/M-006 failure pattern of Engineers inventing fixes before bundle structure was confirmed.

I have everything I need to synthesize. --- # Đề xuất tổ chức Agent-Team cho TikMax (synthesis 5 lens) ## 1. VERDICT — Org hiện tại có đủ tốt không? **KHÔNG — cần restructuring, nhưng là restructuring NHẮM ĐÚNG, không phải đập đi xây lại.** Tier-by-size doctrine (Trivial/Easy/Medium/Large) là **đúng** và có bằng chứng: M-001 (1 agent, Gate 32 sạch), M-004 (3 agent, 8816ms→147ms). Giữ nguyên. Nhưng tier-only org **thiếu 2 thứ làm hỏng cả M-003→M-005→M-006→M-007** (4 mission cho 1 việc): 1. **Không có gate "đọc gốc TRƯỚC khi sửa".** Bằng chứng đắt giá nhất: trong `scout-goc-loading-analysis.md` (báo cáo M-005), Scout **đã đọc được** `deobfuscated.js:13344` — gốc dùng plain `` — nhưng lại đề xuất Track 1/2/3 (sequence prewarm, loading=lazy, onerror fallback) **thay vì** "replicate gốc img 1:1". Sự thật quyết định đã nằm trong tay mà không được dùng làm fix chính. M-007 sau đó chỉ làm đúng 1 việc: đọc gốc, copy 1:1, revert hết. Đáng lẽ đó là nước đi ĐẦU TIÊN của M-005. 2. **Tier dùng `#files` để đo độ khó, nhưng đọc bundle obfuscated KHÔNG BAO GIỜ trivial dù ít file.** Vì vậy M-003 bị xếp solo → clobbered, M-005 bắt đầu bằng guess. Org thiếu trục **DOMAIN** để quyết định AI làm + gate nào áp. **Kết luận:** giữ trục SIZE, thêm trục DOMAIN nhẹ, và đóng đinh **1 hard gate** (read-gốc-first). Đây là 3 thay đổi cao đòn bẩy, không phải 15 thay đổi. --- ## 2. Org model đề xuất — 2 trục: DIFFICULTY × DOMAIN **SIZE quyết định HEADCOUNT. DOMAIN quyết định AI + GATE nào.** Tier table cũ giữ nguyên cho headcount. ### 5 standing domain squads (theo đúng cluster công việc thực tế) | Domain | Surface / file sở hữu | Read-gốc gate? | Reviewer chuyên trách | |---|---|---|---| | **A. Đây chính là carve-out quan trọng nhất — bug UI bundle "known pattern, gốc đọc được" = Easy, KHÔNG phải Large. Electron change → Electron reviewer review, không phải Demolition generic. --- ## 3. #1 PROCESS FIX — Hard gate "READ-GỐC-FIRST" (committable vào CLAUDE.md §2.1) > ### §2.1.0 RESEARCH GATE — Replicate-gốc-first (BẮT BUỘC, không skip) > > **TRIGGER:** Bất kỳ mission nào chạm domain A (Bundle-RE/UI-render) hoặc D (CSS/DevExtreme) — tức bất kỳ thay đổi nào override cách bundle render (`itemTemplate`, `fieldTemplate`, `earlyCss`, DevExtreme layout, chip/dropdown/list UI). > > **YÊU CẦU (exit criteria — mission KHÔNG rời pha SCOUTING cho tới khi đủ):** > 1. Tồn tại file `.codex/team/mNNN-goc-.md` do Scout-Goc viết, chứa **dải dòng chính xác** trong `decompiled/modules/deobfuscated.js` (vd `13335-13363`) + **cấu trúc element/CSS VERBATIM** của gốc cho surface đó. > 2. Chỉ được "phát minh" structure mới (div-bg, flexbox wrapper) SAU khi replicate verbatim đã được chứng minh là fail, với bằng chứng fail ghi vào war-room. *(M-005 div-bg và M-006 wrapper đều vi phạm luật này — cả hai bị M-007 revert.)* > > **NO Engineer spawn cho tới khi gate xanh.** Không có file `mNNN-goc-*.md` = chưa có file ownership grant cho Engineer. critique.finalRecommendation:
Adopt the kernel, reject the scaffolding. The proposal contains exactly two changes worth committing: (1) elevate the already-present 'read-gốc-first / replicate-before-invent' principle from a DO/DON'T bullet into a tier-gated checklist trigger for bundle-UI and CSS missions, and (2) enforce the current_state.json update on mission-complete. Both are near-zero cost and address a real, evidenced gap (enforcement, not absence — the principle is already written across CLAUDE.md §0.0/§1.3/§4 and decisions.md 'PROBE BEFORE SEED').

Reject the rest as overcomplication for a one-person operation: the 5 standing domain squads, per-domain dedicated reviewers, the new mandatory mNNN-goc-*.md artifact, the formal deviation statement, and the consensus/reconciliation 'guards' all restate or duplicate doctrine that already exists in SKILL.md §1 and CLAUDE.md §1.00. They add a second org axis and lookup overhead the Commander's existing right-sizing already covers.

Most importantly: the proposal's central narrative is not grounded. The 'smoking gun' misreads the decisive artifact — m007-goc-dropdowncss.md explicitly says KEEP M-005 and KEEP M-006 ('M-006 is NECESSARY'), it did NOT revert the wrapper, and the M-005 image failure was diagnosed as expired signed CDN URLs (scout-goc-loading-analysis.md), not a structural deviation that '1:1 gốc replication' would have fixed. The §4c 'double-slash false positive' has no supporting war-room file. Before committing even the kernel, correct the rationale to what the evidence actually shows: the team had the right instinct in doctrine, reached the right fix once the user pointed at gốc, and the genuine lesson is 'enforce the existing read-gốc gate for render-override work, tier-gated so trivial edits stay fast' — a one-paragraph doctrine patch, not a reorg.
